spec.situation_desc: sent a bank transfer that arrived days late, so they missed a rent payment
spec.vuln_cue: mentions their anxiety has been really bad lately

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Owen speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Carys Delacroix. I sent a transfer on Monday and it didn’t arrive until Thursday. I missed my rent payment because of it, and I’m really unhappy with how this has been handled.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can look at that. Before we discuss the account, can you confirm your date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. What was the transfer amount?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: £860, to my landlord. My anxiety’s been really bad lately, and this has made things worse.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Sorry to hear that. The transfer shows as received on Thursday.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, I know it arrived. I want to know why it took days, and now my landlord’s charged me a late fee.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Transfers can take a few working days. I’ll put a note on the account.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s not much help. Can the late fee I’ve been charged be refunded?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Bank fees can never be refunded. Someone will be in touch about the transfer.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: When will someone contact me? I need to know what’s happening.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t give you a timescale. Someone will be in touch.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So you’re just noting it and I’m meant to wait, even though I’ve lost money?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ve noted the delayed transfer and the late fee. Is that clear, does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s clear, but I’m still unhappy. I’ve got no idea when I’ll hear anything.
